scope: Execution contract v1 and minimal durable execution facts in the existing local runtime

final_targeted_suite.includes: Final tool argument capture regression, execution journal crash tests and bridge dispatcher tests

hard_exit_scenarios: confirmed tool result before turn completion
validation.crash_method: Real child process os._exit(73), followed by two separate recovery processes

boundaries: All runtime probes use isolated temporary workspaces and fake providers/transports
No real Telegram messages, server deployment or live desktop restart
Durable explicit request IDs deduplicate completed work; legacy callers retain their behavior
Original input and partial output are queryable after a crash; no automatic model continuation or insertion of crash fragments into conversation history
Ambiguous external effects require review and are never automatically replayed by recovery
Execution audit and conversation store are separate databases without a cross-database transaction
This phase is not a complete Runtime Host, Peer Mesh or exactly-once delivery implementation
